newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Federated Department Stores sells debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Federated Department Stores sells debt.

text.p: The following two-tranche debt issue from Federated Department Stores was priced Wednesday, according to lead manager Goldman Sachs & Co.
The $300 million in 20-year debentures were increased from an original size of $250 million, sources said.
Federated operates more than 400 full-time department stores in densely populated urban or suburban markets in 33 states.
